identity.title: [v0.92.1][CORP-04] Establish company billing recovery MFA and vault custody

values.task_boundary: Implement only CORP-04 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Redacted service custody matrix and recovery test record.
Company-controlled administrative and billing readback with named role, not credential, ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Every critical service has a company-controlled administrator, billing owner, secure MFA, recovery route, and vault location.
Recovery is exercised without relying solely on a founder-owned phone, email, card, or device.
Break-glass access is bounded, audited, and distinct from routine credentials.
The repository records names and outcomes only; no credential material is retained.
non_goals: Treating personal billing linkage as corporate custody
